variant_desc: 10k separate calls with same key -> static cache of last (key,result) pair
novelty_rationale: Tests function-level memoization across separate user-callsite invocations -- distinct from in-loop hoisting (SR-1). A compiler cannot insert a static cache into a function it didn't introduce because the cache would mutate observable behavior on reuse, and the no-inline boundary blocks any cross-call optimization.
